Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event Messages is used to signal key market or data feed control events.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Denotes the NLS type of system event for which the message is being generated.

Message.Name: Trade Report Message
Message.Description: The following message is used to relay Nasdaq execution system and TRF trade transactions that are reported for the current business day. Please note that Nasdaq only reports one-side of a trade execution on the Nasdaq Last Sale (NLS) feed and other data feed products.

Field.Name: Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq market system that generated the trade report message.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq-assigned issue symbol of the security for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Denotes the report price on the trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Indicates the reported number of shares on the trade transaction.

Field.Name: Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Sale condition modifier consists of four levels.

Message.Name: Long Form Trade Report Message
Message.Description: The following message is used to relay Nasdaq execution system and TRF trade transactions that are reported for the current business day, for long form trades exceeding the upper limit of a 4-byte price.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq market system that generated the trade report message.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq-assigned issue symbol of the security for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: The price associated with the trade transaction being reported.

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Indicates the reported number of shares on the trade transaction.

Field.Name: Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Sale condition modifier consists of four levels.

Message.Name: NextShares Trade Report Message
Message.Description: The following message is used to relay Nasdaq execution system and TRF trade transactions for Exchange Traded Managed Funds (NextShares) that are reported for the current business day.

Field.Name: Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq market system that generated the trade report message.

Field.Name: NextShares Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the symbol of the NextShares for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Proxy Price
Field.Description: Denotes the proxy price on the NextShares trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Indicates the reported number of shares on the trade transaction.

Field.Name: NAV Premium/Discount Amount
Field.Description: The NAV premium or discount that should be applied to the Proxy Price. This is a signed (+/-) field.

Field.Name: Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Sale condition modifier consists of four levels.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Error Message
Message.Description: The following message is used in the event that a Nasdaq or TRF trade transaction is cancelled on the same business day that it is reported.

Field.Name: Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq market system that generated the trade report and cancel/error message.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq-assigned issue symbol of the security for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Original Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Price
Field.Description: Reported price for the transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Size
Field.Description: Reported number of shares for transaction.

Field.Name: Original Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Defines the sale condition modifiers as reported on the original trade transaction.

Message.Name: Long Form Trade Cancel Error Message
Message.Description: The following message is used in the event that a Nasdaq trade transaction, exceeding the upper limit of a 4-byte price, is cancelled on the same business day that it is reported.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq market system that generated the trade report and cancel/error message.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq-assigned issue symbol of the security for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Original Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Price
Field.Description: Reported price for the original trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Size
Field.Description: Reported number of shares for original trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Defines the sale condition modifiers as reported on the original trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Price

Field.Name: Original NAV Premium/Discount Amount
Field.Description: Original NAV premium or discount originally applied to the Proxy Price. This is a signed (+/-) field.

Field.Name: Original Trade Size

Field.Name: Original Sale Condition Modifier

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Nasdaq-assigned indicator for issue for which the trading action message is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the issue.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reflects the Market Ops or Market Watch code for the trading state change (Appendix C).

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq processes orders based on the most recent Reg SHO Restriction status value.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in the Nasdaq system.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market or listing market tier for the issue.

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: For Nasdaq-listed issues, this field indicates when a firm is not in compliance with Nasdaq continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue.

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if Nasdaq system limits order entry for issue.

Field.Name: Issue Classification
Field.Description: Identifies the security class for the issue as assigned by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Issue Sub Type
Field.Description: Identifies the security sub-type for the issue as assigned by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Denotes if an issue or quoting participant record is set-up in Nasdaq systems in a live/production, test, or demo state.

Field.Name: Short Sale Threshold Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is subject to mandatory close-out of short sales under SEC Rule 203(b)(3).

Field.Name: IPO Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the Nasdaq security is set up for IPO release.

Field.Name: LULD Reference Price Tier
Field.Description: Indicates which Limit Up / Limit Down price band calculation parameter is to be used for the instrument.

Field.Name: ETP Flag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the security is an exchange traded product (ETP).

Field.Name: ETP Leverage Factor
Field.Description: Tracks the integral relationship of the ETP to the underlying index.

Field.Name: Inverse Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the directional relationship between the ETP and underlying index.

Field.Name: Bloomberg ID
Field.Description: The composite ID that Bloomberg has assigned to the security.

Message.Name: Adjusted Closing Price Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates the adjusted closing price for all active symbols in the Nasdaq system.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Adjusted Closing Price
Field.Description: The previous trading day's official closing price adjusted for any applicable corporate actions.

Message.Name: Long Form Adjusted Closing Price Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates the adjusted closing price for all active symbols in the Nasdaq system, only for securities that have exceeded the upper limit of a 4-byte price.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Nasdaq-assigned indicator for the issue.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Adjusted Closing Price
Field.Description: The previous trading day's official closing price adjusted for any applicable corporate actions.

Message.Name: MWCB Decline Level Message
Message.Description: Informs data recipients what the daily MWCB breach points are set to for the current trading day.

Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level 1 Value.

Field.Name: Level 2
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level 2 Value.

Field.Name: Level 3

Message.Name: MWCB Status Message
Message.Description: Informs data recipients when a MWCB has breached one of the established levels.

Field.Name: Breached Level

Message.Name: IPO Quoting Period Update Message
Message.Description: Indicates the anticipated IPO quotation release time of a security.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: IPO Quotation Release Time
Field.Description: Denotes the IPO release time, in seconds since midnight, for quotation to the nearest second.

Field.Name: IPO Quotation Release Qualifier
Field.Description: IPO Quotation Release Qualifier.

Field.Name: IPO Price
Field.Description: Denotes the IPO price to be used for intraday net change calculations.
